Name: Clint Concurrent Upgrades
Author: Mistogose
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Clint Concurrent Upgrades[/b] expands Clint’s blacksmith services by allowing multiple tool upgrades to be ordered without waiting for the previous one to finish.
Every tool keeps its own delivery date and is safely stored with its enchantments and modded data intact. Pending upgrades can be viewed and managed through a dedicated order board and an adaptive HUD.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]ClintConcurrentUpgrades[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The installed folder should directly contain
[code]manifest.json[/code]and
[code]ClintConcurrentUpgrades.dll[/code].
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Order multiple tool upgrades from Clint.[/*]
[*]Independent delivery dates for every tool.[/*]
[*]Dedicated [b]Upgrade Orders[/b] menu.[/*]
[*]Adaptive HUD with one icon per pending tool.[/*]
[*]Clear working, waiting and ready-for-delivery indicators.[/*]
[*]Optional work queue with configurable concurrent work slots.[/*]
[*]Reorder waiting tools by priority.[/*]
[*]Rent temporary tools while Clint works on yours.[/*]
[*]Individual durability system for rented tools.[/*]
[*]Optional urgent service that reduces an order’s delivery time.[/*]
[*]Optional mail delivery through Mail Framework Mod.[/*]
[*]Permanent reputation levels based on completed orders and friendship with Clint.[/*]
[*]Reputation rewards include discounts, free rentals and additional work capacity.[/*]
[*]Configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu or
[code]config.json[/code].[/*]
[*]English and Spanish localization.[/*]
[*]Controller and keyboard navigation support.[/*]
[*]Existing vanilla tool upgrades are migrated automatically.[/*]
[*]Preserves enchantments and custom data added by other mods.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or a compatible version[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — configure the mod from the game menus.[/*]
[*][b]Mail Framework Mod 1.20.0 or later[/b] — enables delivery of completed tools by mail.[/*]
[/list]Mail Framework Mod is only required for mail delivery. All other features work without it.
UI Info Suite 2 is not required. If installed, its other indicators continue to work normally.
[heading]Important[/heading]
Before uninstalling the mod, collect every tool still held by Clint. This prevents pending tools from remaining stored in the mod’s internal data.
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
Thanks to the SMAPI team, the Stardew Valley modding community and everyone who tests, translates and provides feedback for the mod.
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Clint Concurrent Upgrades[/b] expands Clint's blacksmith services by allowing multiple tool upgrades to be ordered without waiting for the previous one to finish.
Each tool keeps its own delivery date and is safely stored with its enchantments, custom data and modded information intact.
Pending upgrades can be viewed and managed through a dedicated [b]Upgrade Orders[/b] board, with multiple ways to access it and an adaptive HUD that keeps track of your active orders.
The mod is designed to work with existing saves and automatically handles vanilla tool upgrades already in progress.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/b].[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]ClintConcurrentUpgrades[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The installed folder should directly contain:
[code]manifest.json[/code]and
[code]ClintConcurrentUpgrades.dll[/code][heading]Updating[/heading]
Existing saves are compatible with newer versions of the mod.
When updating:
[list=1]
[*]Close Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Delete the previous
[code]ClintConcurrentUpgrades[/code]folder from your
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Install the new version.[/*]
[*]Launch the game normally through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Do not merge files from different versions of the mod.[/b]
Your existing orders and save data will remain compatible unless otherwise stated in the release notes.
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Order multiple tool upgrades from Clint.[/*]
[*]Independent delivery dates for every tool.[/*]
[*]Dedicated [b]Upgrade Orders[/b] board for viewing and managing pending upgrades.[/*]
[*]Open the [b]Upgrade Orders[/b] board in three different ways:
[list]
[*]Talk to Clint.[/*]
[*]Click the tool icon in the HUD.[/*]
[*]Use a configurable keyboard or controller shortcut.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Default shortcut:
[list]
[*][b]Keyboard:[/b]
[code]O[/code][/*]
[*][b]Controller:[/b] Press the [b]Left Stick[/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Shortcut controls can be changed through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/*]
[*]Adaptive HUD with one icon per pending tool.[/*]
[*]HUD interaction correctly adapts to different interface scale and zoom settings.[/*]
[*]Clear indicators for:
[list]
[*]Tools currently being worked on.[/*]
[*]Tools waiting in the queue.[/*]
[*]Tools ready for pickup.[/*]
[*]Tools reserved for mail delivery.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Optional work queue with configurable concurrent work slots.[/*]
[*]Reorder waiting tools by priority.[/*]
[*]Rent temporary tools while Clint works on yours.[/*]
[*]Individual durability system for rented tools.[/*]
[*]Optional urgent service that reduces an order's delivery time.[/*]
[*]Optional mail delivery through [b]Mail Framework Mod[/b].[/*]
[*]Permanent reputation levels based on completed orders and friendship with Clint.[/*]
[*]Reputation rewards can include:
[list]
[*]Discounts.[/*]
[*]Free rentals.[/*]
[*]Additional work capacity.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Reputation events are safely tracked and only marked as viewed after successfully opening.[/*]
[*]Configurable through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] or:
[code]config.json[/code][/*]
[*]Full localization support for:
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]Spanish[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Controller and keyboard navigation support.[/*]
[*]Existing vanilla tool upgrades are migrated automatically.[/*]
[*]Preserves enchantments and custom data added by other mods.[/*]
[*]Includes additional SMAPI diagnostic messages when the orders board cannot open because of:
[list]
[*]Events.[/*]
[*]Open menus.[/*]
[*]Tool actions.[/*]
[*]Player states.[/*]
[*]Other gameplay conditions blocking interaction.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
Required
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] or a compatible version.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/b].[/*]
[/list]Optional
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
Provides an in-game configuration menu and allows easy customization of the orders board shortcut and other settings.[/*]
[*][b]Mail Framework Mod 1.20.0 or later[/b]
Enables delivery of completed tools by mail.[/*]
[/list][b]Mail Framework Mod is only required for mail delivery.[/b]
All other features work without it.
[b]UI Info Suite 2 is not required.[/b]
If installed, its other indicators continue to work normally.
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Existing saves are supported.
The mod automatically migrates compatible vanilla tool upgrades already in progress.
Tool data is preserved while Clint is working on an upgrade, including:
[list]
[*]Enchantments.[/*]
[*]Custom mod data.[/*]
[*]Modded tool information.[/*]
[/list]This helps maintain compatibility with other mods that add information or modifications to tools.
[heading]Important[/heading]
Before uninstalling the mod, collect every tool still being held by Clint.
This prevents pending tools from remaining stored in the mod's internal save data.
[heading]Troubleshooting[/heading]
If the [b]Upgrade Orders[/b] board does not open, check the SMAPI console.
Version 1.1 includes additional diagnostic messages that can identify situations where the board is temporarily blocked by an event, menu, tool action or another player state.
When reporting an issue, providing your SMAPI log can make troubleshooting significantly easier.
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
Thanks to the [b]SMAPI team[/b], the [b]Stardew Valley modding community[/b], translators, testers and everyone who reports issues or provides feedback for the mod.
